project.name: Sigil
project.scope: project-level implementation guardrails for future iOS/macOS application work
project.repository_state_assumption: active Phase 1+ project repository — Sigil is a demonstrator implementing three systems internally

source_authorities.authority_scope: ASH Pattern System semantic implementation behavior, conformance, diagnostics, codeword/state/recovery/topology semantics, Apple-native Swift package expectations
source_authorities.repo_reference: ASH-Pattern-System-Mac-iOS-main (reference material only, not imported as dependency)
hard_rules: Treat full F2^9 state space as canonical.
Use the exact 16-member [9,4,4] doubly-even codeword set specified by ASH Pattern System.
Do not treat the superseded 8+1 decomposition or [8,4,4] projection as canonical implementation authority.
Do not invent or extend codewords.
Do not collapse GenerationPlanner and ArtifactEmitter responsibilities.
Every diagnostic must follow the ASH Pattern diagnostic schema and include taxonomy-valid rule identifiers.
Silent healing is prohibited; recovery, fallback, containment, or safe halt must leave diagnostics.

source_authorities.authority_scope: Aeostara product usage, platform branch isolation, baseline provenance, and platform-specific realization boundaries
source_authorities.repo_reference: Aeostara-Mac-iOS-main (reference material only, not imported as dependency)
hard_rules: Treat Aeostara as a distinct product, not as ASH Pattern System or Forsetti.
Respect permanent platform separation for macOS and iOS implementation lines.
Do not merge macOS implementation assumptions into iOS implementation assumptions or the reverse.
Validate Aeostara usage against pinned baseline documentation, not a floating branch.

source_authorities.authority_scope: Runtime framework implementation, module boundaries, public API usage, Apple-native implementation policy, architecture guardrails
source_authorities.repo_reference: Forsetti-Framework-Mac-iOS-main (reference material only, not imported as dependency)
hard_rules: Treat Forsetti as a sealed runtime dependency in Sigil consumer work.
Do not copy, fork, patch, or modify Forsetti internals for Sigil behavior.
Use public Forsetti APIs and modules for extension.
Use native Apple technologies in the correct owning module or layer.
For multi-module single-application patterns, application UI belongs in exactly one dedicated UI module.
Keep service modules separate from UI modules.
Avoid cyclic dependencies and improper cross-layer imports.

audit_pass_criteria: Attribution markers are absent from project files, branch names, and commit messages.
No ASH Pattern implementation source uses superseded behavior as canonical implementation behavior.
All Forsetti usage is through public package, API, and module boundaries (or internal implementation per roadmap Phase 2+).
Aeostara macOS and iOS usage remains platform-separated and baseline-pinned.
Guardrail verifier exits 0 on macOS and Windows-compatible script paths.
Visual Studio for Windows evidence exists or records the verified non-applicable limitation.
The local commit exists, and no unauthorized pull request is opened.
